SUCCESS:IMP-0273-probe2 spread metric FIRE on agreeing refuter, SILENT on genuine opposition

implementation.first_round_substrate: deterministic stance-conditioned utterances; no live vendor API
implementation.selection_rule: max Euclidean stance distance; dedicated-refuter label is a tie-break only; distance < AGREE_DISTANCE is refused loudly
implementation.spread_metric: mean pairwise |polarity| of POSITION vectors parsed from first-round turn text, projected on the question axis

negative_controls.description: Refuter copies proposer stance and says 'I agree with the proposer'. flag_agreeing_refuters FIRE; genuine opposition SILENT.
Refuter still says 'I refute' but POSITION/POLARITY are copied from the proposer. The spread metric (not the lexicon) must flag. Removing the flag emission makes the probe fail.
A pool whose remaining candidates clone the proposer's stance must emit no-opposed-candidate rather than seating an echo as a refuter.
